title: OpenCity
tagline: Zone homes, shops and factories in 3D, power them and connect them with roads, and watch the city grow.
summary: OpenCity is a free 3D city simulation: you zone residential, commercial and industrial land, lay roads and power lines, build coal and nuclear power plants, fire and police stations, schools, hospitals, parks and trees, and raise or lower the terrain. The zones grow into bigger buildings when they have power, a road and the other two kinds of zone nearby; traffic and cars follow.

Every new city is a generated landscape of 50 by 50 squares with lakes and forests. Taxes come in once a year, every road, line, tree and public building costs maintenance each month, and the money is shown with the population and the date in the status bar.

This port follows OpenCity 0.0.6.5stable with its tool circles, status bar, main menu and 3D view; its simulation, map generator and save file are checked against the original's own code. Your saved city is kept in your account.
caveat: Honest note: two textures of the original contain photographs under non-free licenses (the hospital's bricks, windows and fan; the shipping containers). They are replaced by textures we drew ourselves (CC0), in the same layout, so the hospital and the container yard look plainer than in the original. Everything else is the original's data.

Zoom; with Ctrl move left/right, with Shift move up/down
